title: The 8 Levels of Relationship Follower Counts
house: A neon-lit urban metropolis populated entirely by living fruit and vegetable people, filled with coffee shops, subway cars, and glowing digital numbers on everyone's foreheads.
links: The barista from level 2 always mentions a quiet carrot man leaving massive tips.
The broken neon sign at the bus stop flickers in every single episode.
A dropped golden coin rolls across the pavement in the background of each level.

levels.open_loop: Why did my boyfriend suddenly block me on every app after seeing my follower count?

gegenspieler.tat: Laughs at her low follower count in the café and calls her a ghost account.

levels.name: Mia, 21, Student
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship follower counts. Level 1. Du hast 42 Follower? Dann bist du für mich Luft, verpiss dich aus meinem Leben! I sat alone at the corner booth of the neon diner, clutching my cold tea, staring at my glowing forehead display. My stem drooped in utter defeat as he walked past my table with his new partner. You are an absolute zero to me, nobody wants to date a ghost with forty-two followers. My heart shattered into a million tiny pieces right there on the sticky floor. I whispered to myself, remembering how much time and energy I wasted trying to impress him, posting pictures every single day just to gain a tiny shred of validation, only to be discarded like garbage over a ridiculous digital metric. You will see that in Level 2. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Oliver, 24, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship follower counts. Level 2. I was steaming oat milk behind the counter when she walked in with her high-profile date, checking her engagement metrics every ten seconds. You only have eighteen hundred followers, Oliver, how are we supposed to attend the brand gala together? I wiped the counter slowly, feeling the burning heat of humiliation rise up my orange peel skin. Inside my head, the agonizing thought echoed louder and louder: why must every single human connection be measured by numbers and clout? I poured the hot water, shaking with sheer anger at how easily people sell out their own dignity for a couple of thousand artificial views, standing there feeling utterly worthless while everyone stared at my forehead. Who sent the anonymous message claiming my new partner is hiding their real analytics? You will see that in Level 3. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Chloe, 25, Influencer
levels.story: The 8 levels of relationship follower counts. Level 4. I sat in my sterile white studio surrounded by ring lights, editing a video about couple goals while my boyfriend packed his designer suitcases. He threw his phone onto the vanity mirror, shattering the glass into a spiderweb of cracks and sharp edges. One hundred and twenty-four thousand followers and you still have to fake every single date for the algorithm! Suddenly, my phone buzzed with violent notifications, and I watched in absolute horror as my ex published a viral post branding me as a manipulative fraud to thousands of trolls. My eggplant skin turned a deep, furious shade of violet as I screamed back at him across the room. You will see that in Level 5. You'll see that in Level 5.
